newsitem.title: USA: Fed's Phillips expects 2.2 pct growth to continue.
newsitem.headline: Fed's Phillips expects 2.2 pct growth to continue.

text.p: Federal Reserve Governor Susan Phillips said Thursday she expects the U.S. economic growth rate to stabilize at 2.2 percent or increase slightly for the remainder of this year.
"My guess is we'll see a continuation of growth at this pace or a bit higher" for the rest of the year, she said at a women's business conference here.
Earlier Thursday, the Commerce Department reported that Gross Domestic Product rose 2.2 percent in the second quarter compared to a downwardly revised 4.9 percent gain in the first quarter.
